title: CodeStorm 4.0 Hackathon
shortDescription: 24-hour intense hackathon where teams solve real-world problems using AI, Web3, and IoT.
description: CodeStorm is ISTE's flagship annual 24-hour hackathon bringing together over 500+ participants from top universities across the region. Innovators hack on cutting-edge problems in AI, Decentralized Tech, EdTech, and Sustainable Smart Cities with mentorship from industry leaders.

title: Tech Unplugged 2026
shortDescription: An interactive tech symposium featuring talks on Next-Gen Web, Cloud Native, and Quantum Computing.
description: Tech Unplugged bridges academic theory with industry practice. Interactive keynotes, live code breakdowns, and Q&A sessions with veteran engineers on microservices, system design, and AI deployment.

title: Annual Tech Colloquium
shortDescription: Panel discussions and lightning talks on ethics in AI and sustainable engineering.
description: The Annual Tech Colloquium gathered distinguished faculty, alumni, and industry pioneers for deep dives into responsible artificial intelligence, cybersecurity frameworks, and student startup ecosystems.

title: Overthrone Gaming & Tech Clash
shortDescription: High-octane competitive gaming tournament and algorithmic problem solving championship.
description: Overthrone combined competitive programming challenges with esports tournaments, testing both logical speed and teamwork under pressure.

title: ISTE Grand Orientation
shortDescription: Welcoming incoming freshmen to the ISTE Student Chapter family with live demos and domain overviews.
description: Our annual welcome event introducing new students to Technical, Design, Content, Operations, and Management domains at ISTE with icebreakers, live project demos, and hands-on mini workshops.

title: Campus Society Showcase
shortDescription: Interactive exhibition highlighting top student projects, robotics hardware, and VR experiences.
description: ISTE showcased interactive 3D web applications, autonomous robotics prototypes, and AR/VR demonstrations to over 2,000 students across campus.
